100.name: Operation Supply Coins
100.display: Can be exchanged for items in the Operation Siren store. Any unspent coins will be lost when operation progress resets.

101.name: Special Item Tokens
101.display: Can be exchanged for special items in the Operation Siren store. Any unspent tokens will be lost when operation progress resets.

102.name: Operation Siren Data Logger
102.display: An information storage device that records data on zones with Siren encroachment. By using it, you can remove all movement restrictions between zones on the Operation Siren map and immediately collect all the zone securing bonuses.

103.name: Arbiter Battle Reward Crate (S)
103.display: A crate dropped by a defeated Arbiter. Will be converted into 100 Supply Shop Vouchers when Operation Siren progress resets.

104.name: Arbiter Battle Reward Crate (M)
104.display: A crate dropped by a defeated Arbiter. Will be converted into 200 Supply Shop Vouchers when Operation Siren progress resets.

105.name: Arbiter Battle Reward Crate (L)
105.display: A crate dropped by a defeated Arbiter. Will be converted into 500 Supply Shop Vouchers when Operation Siren progress resets.

110.name: Energy Storage Device
110.display: A device that stores energy needed to operate Siren-made structures and equipment. Its failsafe construction ensures it will not explode.

120.name: Hidden Zone Data Logger
120.display: A data logger issued by the Naval HQ that specifically stores information obtained in Hidden Zones. When used, automatically scouts all Hidden Zones in Operation Siren, and unlocks Hidden Zone Strategic Search.

201.name: Emergency Repair Pack
201.display: Can be used to restore the HP of 1 ship in your current fleet by 1,000.

202.name: Complete Repair Pack
202.display: Can be used to restore the HP of 1 ship in your current fleet by 3,000.

203.name: Triple Emergency Repair Pack
203.display: Can be used to restore the HP of up to 3 ships in your current fleet by 500.

204.name: Triple Complete Repair Pack
204.display: Can be used to restore the HP of up to 3 ships in your current fleet by 1,500.

205.name: Full Emergency Repair Pack
205.display: Can be used to restore the HP of all ships in your current fleet by 30%.

206.name: Full Complete Repair Pack
206.display: Can be used to restore the HP of all ships in your current fleet by 100%.

251.name: Action Point Refill (S)
251.display: Can be used to restore 20 Action Points.

252.name: Action Point Refill (M)
252.display: Can be used to restore 50 Action Points.

253.name: Action Point Refill (L)
253.display: Can be used to restore 100 Action Points.

301.name: Tuning Sample - Offense
301.display: A decent sample of a Siren enhancement module. Use it to gain 5 points in the Offensive Adaptability stat.

302.name: Tuning Sample - Survivability
302.display: A decent sample of a Siren enhancement module. Use it to gain 5 points in the Survivability Adaptability stat.

303.name: Tuning Sample - Tactics

304.name: Quality Tuning Sample - Offense

306.name: Quality Tuning Sample - Tactics
